name: PDS P-002: a physical drill run with --only-phase/--from-phase executes only the selected phases, refuses a bad selection before any work, is never release evidence, and a real single-phase rig re-run finishes well under the 18-minute full-run floor (live, 2026-09-30)
summary: Three real single-phase re-runs on the physical rig (phases I, H and J), each started from papercusp-desktop/bin/hive-git-drill.sh --only-phase <X>, executed exactly the selected phase, recorded every other phase as PHASE_SKIP ... (not selected), ended with PARTIAL_RUN ... (diagnostic only; no release evidence) and wrote the partial stdout {"releaseEvidence":false}. End-to-end wall time (verification-harness start to the archived per-run evidence dir) was 4m25s, 9m46s and 3m55s, against the 18-minute full-run floor. Seven bad or unusable selections run against the same real entry point at 09:05:56Z were each refused with exit 2 in 24-139 ms, before any rig work.

assertions.criteria: A run asked for one phase executes only that phase and records every other phase as not selected.
assertions.observed: Run 20260930T015526Z-3193378 (--only-phase I): PHASE_SKIP A..H and J '(not selected)', PHASE_START I only. Run 20260930T023044Z-1175578 (--only-phase H): PHASE_SKIP A..G, I, J '(not selected)', PHASE_START H only. Run 20260930T025148Z-2551065 (--only-phase J): PARTIAL_RUN phases=J.

assertions.criteria: A partial run is never signed as release evidence.
assertions.observed: All three runs wrote physical-probe.stdout = {"schemaVersion":"hive-git-physical-partial/v1","phases":"<X>","releaseEvidence":false} and a PARTIAL_RUN line ending '(diagnostic only; no release evidence)'. The verification-harness plan for each run selects only the 'physical' phase (selection.only=[physical]); setup, mode and the local legs are recorded skip/not-selected.

assertions.criteria: A real single-phase re-run on the rig finishes well under the 18-minute full-run floor.
assertions.observed: Phase I: harness start 01:55:27.121Z, phase 01:57:08-01:59:43Z, evidence dir 01:59:52Z = 4m25s. Phase H: harness start 02:30:45.600Z, phase 02:32:25-02:40:24Z, evidence dir 02:40:31Z = 9m46s. Phase J: harness start 02:51:49.452Z, phase 02:53:18-02:55:37Z, evidence dir 02:55:44Z = 3m55s. Each includes source pinning, rig preflight and scenario deploy.

assertions.criteria: A bad or unusable selection is refused before any work.
assertions.observed: Against the real entry point papercusp-desktop/bin/hive-git-drill.sh at 2026-09-30T09:05:56Z, all exit 2 before any rig work: '--only-phase Z' 24 ms ('wants A-J letters'); "--only-phase ''" 33 ms; '--only-phase A,B,C,D,E,F,G,H,I,J' 82 ms and '--from-phase A' 30 ms ('is every physical phase - that is the full release run'); '--only-phase D' without HIVE_GIT_PHYSICAL_PROBE_CMD 30 ms; REQUIRE_ZERO_SKIPS=1 with a partial selection 139 ms ('a partial re-run can never satisfy it'); '--rig nowhere' 24 ms ('is not a rig profile').

falsifier: A run asked for a later phase still executes phase A or any other unselected phase; a bad selection fails minutes in instead of refusing up front; a partial run is signed as release evidence; or a single-phase rig re-run takes as long as a full run.
command: bash papercusp-desktop/bin/hive-git-drill.sh --only-phase Z | '' | A,B,C,D,E,F,G,H,I,J; --from-phase A; --only-phase D (no probe cmd); REQUIRE_ZERO_SKIPS=1 --only-phase D; --rig nowhere --only-phase D
note: The three rig runs were real diagnostic re-runs on the physical rig (tower + VM aviweiss@172.31.44.2), pinned sources a1e699b611a0 (I) and fd64b7230bd6 (H). The refusal matrix was run live against the current entry point; selection is validated in lines 99-159 of hive-git-drill.sh before any other work.
